parameters.content:
## Telegram Commands
Every message is parsed and validated first; bad input gets a usage message and never reaches the database.
/watch takes company names or tickers. The Resolve Stock Symbols sub-workflow checks Yahoo first and asks AI only as a last resort (AI answers are re-checked on Yahoo). Yahoo down = nothing saved, the person is told to retry.
/report answers instantly and builds the report in the background (async). /stop deletes all data stored about that person.

parameters.query: insert into mr_subscribers (chat_id, first_name, active) values ($1, $2, true) on conflict (chat_id) do update set first_name = excluded.first_name, active = true returning chat_id

insert into mr_subscribers (chat_id, first_name, active) values ($1, $2, true) on conflict (chat_id) do update set first_name = excluded.first_name, active = true returning chat_id
select chat_id, symbol, name from mr_watchlist where chat_id = $1 order by symbol
insert into mr_watchlist (chat_id, symbol, name) values ($1, $2, $3) on conflict (chat_id, symbol) do nothing
select chat_id, symbol, name from mr_watchlist where chat_id = $1 order by symbol
delete from mr_watchlist where chat_id = $1 and symbol = $2
select chat_id, symbol, name from mr_watchlist where chat_id = $1 order by symbol
select chat_id, report_date, trigger, status from mr_report_log where chat_id = $1 and report_date = $2 and trigger = 'on_demand'
select source, consecutive_failures, last_status, last_checked, simulate_down from mr_source_health order by source
select chat_id, report_date, trigger, status, sections_down, summary_by, sent_at from mr_report_log order by id desc limit 5

insert into mr_source_health (source, simulate_down, consecutive_failures, last_status) values ($1, $2::boolean, $3::int, $4) on conflict (source) do update set simulate_down = excluded.simulate_down, consecutive_failures = excluded.consecutive_failures, last_status = excluded.last_status
